title: Find All Good Indices
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of size n and a positive integer k, identify indices i where k elements before i are in non-increasing order and k elements after i are in non-decreasing order.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of size n and a positive integer k, identify indices i where k elements before i are in non-increasing order and k elements after i are in non-decreasing order. Return these indices sorted in ascending order.
constraints: A good index has at least k elements on each side.
The k immediately preceding values must be non-increasing.
The k immediately following values must be non-decreasing; return all good indexes in ascending order.
hints: Precompute the length of the non-increasing run ending at every position.
Precompute the length of the non-decreasing run starting at every position.
Index i is good when the run ending at i-1 and the run starting at i+1 both have length at least k.
These two run lengths exactly summarize the required adjacent comparisons on each side, allowing a linear scan.
editorial: These two run lengths exactly summarize the required adjacent comparisons on each side, allowing a linear scan.
